nodes.speaker: Orin
nodes.text: Canopy bridges bend; they do not betray. Keep your weight moving and watch for the wind between branches.

nodes.speaker: Orin
nodes.text: What would you like to ask?

nodes.speaker: Orin
nodes.text: Old paths remember patient feet. Look above the obvious road, and listen when the embers hum.

nodes.speaker: Orin
nodes.text: May your next step find solid ground.
